mapper.insert: insert into hr_emp_image ( staff_id, image_type, ability_score, performance_level, skill_tags, work_style, career_orientation, risk_level, model_version, status, tech_ability, workload_ability, quality_ability, contribution_ability, stability_ability, performance_trend, learning_ability, growth_speed, incentive_response, promotion_probability, retention_risk ) values ( #{staff_id}, #{image_type}, #{ability_score}, #{performance_level}, #{skill_tags}, #{work_style}, #{career_orientation}, #{risk_level}, #{model_version}, #{status}, #{tech_ability}, #{workload_ability}, #{quality_ability}, #{contribution_ability}, #{stability_ability}, #{performance_trend}, #{learning_ability}, #{growth_speed}, #{incentive_response}, #{promotion_probability}, #{retention_risk} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ability_score = VALUES(ability_score), performance_level = VALUES(performance_level), skill_tags = VALUES(skill_tags), work_style = VALUES(work_style), career_orientation = VALUES(career_orientation), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), model_version = VALUES(model_version), tech_ability = VALUES(tech_ability), workload_ability = VALUES(workload_ability), quality_ability = VALUES(quality_ability), contribution_ability = VALUES(contribution_ability), stability_ability = VALUES(stability_ability), performance_trend = VALUES(performance_trend), learning_ability = VALUES(learning_ability), growth_speed = VALUES(growth_speed), incentive_response = VALUES(incentive_response), promotion_probability = VALUES(promotion_probability), retention_risk = VALUES(retention_risk), updated_time = NOW()
mapper.select: select ei.*, s.sname, s.sid, ei.tech_ability, ei.workload_ability, ei.quality_ability, ei.contribution_ability, ei.stability_ability, ei.performance_trend, ei.learning_ability, ei.growth_speed, ei.incentive_response, ei.promotion_probability, ei.retention_risk, DATE_FORMAT(ei.created_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as created_time1, DATE_FORMAT(ei.updated_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updated_time1 from hr_emp_image ei left join hr_employee s on ei.staff_id = s.id where ei.id = #{id} and (ei.status = 1 or ei.status is null)

select ei.*, s.sname, s.sid, ei.tech_ability, ei.workload_ability, ei.quality_ability, ei.contribution_ability, ei.stability_ability, ei.performance_trend, ei.learning_ability, ei.growth_speed, ei.incentive_response, ei.promotion_probability, ei.retention_risk, DATE_FORMAT(ei.created_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as created_time1, DATE_FORMAT(ei.updated_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updated_time1 from hr_emp_image ei left join hr_employee s on ei.staff_id = s.id where ei.staff_id = #{staff_id} and (ei.status = 1 or ei.status is null) and ei.image_type = #{image_type} order by ei.created_time desc limit #{limit}

select ei.*, s.sname, s.sid, ei.tech_ability, ei.workload_ability, ei.quality_ability, ei.contribution_ability, ei.stability_ability, ei.performance_trend, ei.learning_ability, ei.growth_speed, ei.incentive_response, ei.promotion_probability, ei.retention_risk, DATE_FORMAT(ei.created_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as created_time1, DATE_FORMAT(ei.updated_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updated_time1 from hr_emp_image ei left join hr_employee s on ei.staff_id = s.id where ei.staff_id = #{staff_id} and (ei.status = 1 or ei.status is null) order by ei.created_time desc
